This weapon is a testament to the unbreakable blood pact: One shall never betray, never surrender, and fight until the last drop of blood is shed.

Bloodpact's Pledge is a Sword weapon in Wuthering Waves. It can be obtained by completing the The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier quest.

Syntonization[]

Syntonizing Bloodpact's Pledge requires the material Core of Oath instead of identical weapons, 2 of which can be obtained through the Septimont Exploration Progress Rewards at 25% and 75% completion, and 2 from Fabricatorium of the Deep and Sanguis Plateaus Exploration Rewards at 75% completion.

Availability[]

  • The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier reward.
